scope: Proposition 3.3 (The completed theory and its coefficients) of the manuscript “A rational obstruction to strong chromatic splitting at height three” (preprints/A-rational-obstruction-to-strong-chromatic-splitting-at-height-three-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d0bd23f35dc42a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are continuous G- equivariant maps of solid E∞-rings E□ 3 −→ B̂□ ←− E□ 2 , (3.3) where G acts through P3 on the first source and through P2 on the second. The right arrow is canonical connected base change. The target is even periodic, with π0B̂□ (∗) ≃ W(L̂)[[u′ 1]]. Invariantly, its coefficients are complete base changes of the height-two deformation ring and its invertible even coefficient lines. The natural map W(L̂) → π0B̂□ is G-equivariant. Every profinite evaluation B̂□(T) is an ordinary K(2)-local spectrum. The second map in (3.3) induces an H-equivariant equivalence E□ 2 ∼ − − → (B̂□ )hP1 3 , where Z acts trivially on the source. Moreover, for every t ∈ Z it induces an equivalence on the individual coefficient complexes πtE□ 2 ∼ − − → RΓ(P1 3 , πtB̂□ ). In particular, for s ≥ 0 and all t there are natural isomorphisms Hs (H, πtE□ 2 ) ∼ − − → Hs (G, πtB̂□ ). (3.4) These comparisons preserve the coefficient maps from Witt constants. Finally, put Δ = Gal(k/Fp) and Gn = Pn ⋊ Δ. The ordinary stabilizer-descent identifi- cation is ( (E□ n )hGn ) (∗) ≃ LK(n)S, n = 2, 3, compatibly with the canonical maps to En.
